name: aljehad-app
description: AL-JEHAD Project Control — mobile app (wraps aljehad-projects.netlify.app)

scripts.add:android: cap add android && node scripts/patch-native.mjs android && capacitor-assets generate --android --iconBackgroundColor '#0E332B' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#0E332B' --splashBackgroundColor '#0E332B' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#0E332B' && cap sync android
scripts.add:ios: cap add ios && node scripts/patch-native.mjs ios && capacitor-assets generate --ios --iconBackgroundColor '#0E332B' --splashBackgroundColor '#0E332B' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#0E332B' && cap sync ios
